summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Settings Tab → General Details page. All 28 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified all form sections load correctly with API data, dropdowns work (Categories, Tags, Co-hosts), and Save Changes button successfully updates event via PUT API.
critical_code_review_comments: All Master Data APIs properly implemented: GET/POST categories, GET/POST tags with search, GET users
Event General Details APIs working: GET /api/events/:eventId/general returns full event with category, tags, co_hosts, media
PUT /api/events/:eventId/general updates event and correctly handles tag_ids and cohost_ids arrays
Event Media APIs working: GET/POST/DELETE for event media
Frontend SettingsGeneral.tsx properly fetches data on load and populates all form fields
Save Changes button correctly submits form data to PUT API with success toast notification
All dropdowns (Category, Tags, Co-hosts) populated from master data APIs
Tags dropdown includes 'Create new tag' option for inline tag creation
seed_data_creation: Categories: Conference, Workshop, Meetup, Awards, Webinar, Networking, Training, Seminar. Tags: Technology, Business, Innovation, Networking, Startup, AI, Design. Users: Admin User (admin@example.com)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings Tab → General Details page fully functional. APIs tested: GET /api/master/categories (list), POST /api/master/categories (create), GET /api/master/tags (list with search), POST /api/master/tags (create), GET /api/master/users (list), GET /api/events/:eventId/general (full event details), PUT /api/events/:eventId/general (update with tag_ids, cohost_ids), GET/POST/DELETE /api/events/:eventId/media. Frontend displays: Event Banner upload, Basic Information (name, category, description, event type, visibility, check-in mode), Organizer & Tags (owner, co-hosts, tags), Date & Time (start/end dates, timezone, all-day toggle), Registration Settings (open/close dates, capacity, waitlist), Location (mode, venue, address, meeting URL), Event Media (promo video URL), Accessibility & Safety (notes, emergency contact). Save Changes button triggers PUT API and shows success toast.
